symbols.name: two-point butterfly
symbols.meaning: The map sending a pair of values to its scaled sum and scaled difference.
symbols.quote: Write $u$ and $v$ for two input values; the two-point butterfly $H_0$ maps them to $\left(\frac{u+v}{2}, \frac{u-v}{2}\right)$.
